name: Tabeal
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Syria, Ephraim, and Remaliah's son took evil counsel, saying, "Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and set a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeal."

note.label: Isaiah 7: Ahaz, the Confederacy, and the Sign of Immanuel
